commitments.detail: Selected based on the highest overall score in the accuracy and throughput evaluation.
Implementing a managed service to scan for exposed credentials in all new and changed repositories.
All new and changed repositories will be scanned for exposed credentials.
The selected provider has passed the planned accuracy and throughput evaluation.
The annual price for the selected service is $15,000.
To protect against credential exposure, we will use providerB to scan all new and changed repositories.
